title: Galois-Ring Diffusion for Integer-Ring Ciphers
summary: Galois-ring diffusion is proposed as an alternative to matrix multiplication in ciphers over integer rings, but constructing and studying this case remains open.

formal_statement.body: Study the construction of ciphers over $\mathbb{Z}_{p^n}^{\,t}$ in which the matrix-multiplication component is replaced by a function over $\operatorname{GR}(p^n,t)$ that provides diffusion.

scope.domain: Symmetric-cipher construction over integer rings using Galois-ring diffusion functions.
parameters: p, n, and t: parameters defining the integer-ring cipher space and the Galois ring
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct and study ciphers in which matrix multiplication is replaced by a diffusion-providing function over the Galois ring.

citations.label: The ABC of Symmetric Primitives over Integer Rings: Milk Before Meat

progress.summary: The source presents this replacement as an alternative cipher-construction strategy and explicitly leaves studying the case open for future work.
citation_labels: Tim Beyne et al., The ABC of Symmetric Primitives over Integer Rings: Milk Before Meat
